messages.content:
Risk: Harmful code generation
Description: Models might generate code that causes harm or unintentionally affects other systems.
Concern: The execution of harmful code might open vulnerabilities in IT systems.
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#T0820: Exploitation for Evasion - ATTACK ICS — Adversaries may exploit a software vulnerability to take advantage of a programming error in a program, service, or within the operating system software or kernel itself to evade detection. Vulnerabilities may exist in software that can be used to disable or circumvent security features. [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: Rootkit - ATTACK ICS, Spoof Reporting Message - ATTACK ICS, System Binary Proxy Execution - ATTACK ICS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0018.000: Poison AI Model - ATLAS — Adversaries may manipulate an AI model's weights to change it's behavior or performance, resulting in a poisoned model.
Adversaries may poison a model by by directly manipulating its weights, training the model on poisoned data, further fine-tuning the model, or otherwise interfering with its training process.

The change in behavior of poisoned models may be limited to targeted categories in predictive AI models, or targeted topics, concepts, or facts in generative AI models, or aim for a general performance degradation. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Embed Malware - ATLAS, Modify AI Model Architecture - ATLAS
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/RiskLevel: risk level — None [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: moneyness, market level classifier, occurrence kind
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 2/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the risk of harmful code generation by describing the exploitation of vulnerabilities, which aligns with the concern of vulnerabilities in IT systems.
This class describes instructions that cause harm when executed, directly addressing the concern of harmful code generation and its potential consequences.
